overall_notes: The paper focuses on task-oriented plan generation using LLMs with constrained decoding. The extraction was generally accurate but contained some duplicates and inconsistent naming. The paper uses only automatic evaluation metrics, no human or LLM-as-judge evaluation. The FLAP algorithm is the main contribution, showing improved faithfulness in plan generation.
